property_summary: For every admissible Put(t) executed at time now, the stored unlock time for the depositor equals max(t, now) — in particular it is never a timestamp already in the past — while the mutant stores the raw t and records a past unlock time whenever t < now.
change_summary: Set unlockTime unconditionally to _unlockTime instead of clamping to at least block.timestamp, changing the stored unlock time observable via Acc(msg.sender).
